set.body:
Implement the smallest reading-specific slice above aoi: explicitly ordered word identities and first-pass reading time over assigned events, with named regression/skip/overlap/missingness conventions. Reuse AoiSet and visit interruption decisions; do not infer reading order from map iteration or coordinate sorting. Acceptance: hand-authored sequences with skips, regressions, ties and interruption boundaries; public consumer and export coverage. Define a continuation list for rereading, regression path, landing position and remaining reference measures; first-pass alone does not close reading.

Keep each implementation review below roughly half a day; if the scope exceeds that, split before implementation and retain the parent acceptance. Follow repository law/mutation and landing gates. This is required gap work owned by the comparison epic; completion needs evidence, not title closure.
set.title: PM1.4 Add ordered reading AOIs and first-pass reading-time semantics
